items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Did you have Phil Urso, too? For a short period, yeah.

ctx.x: That was a whole different grouping again.
Yeah. Did you have Phil Urso, too?

For a short period, yeah. That was the band that once again, Perkins and a lot of different guys. And Doug Mettome, marvelous trumpet player and a young man that -- from Minnesota, another great trumpet player, it's a Nordic name and I can't think of it. Don Fagerquist.
